== About this wiki ==
Dwarf Fortress Wiki used to be hosted by a guy named [[user:Briess|Briess]]. He is awesome. The server has many numbers and the numbers are very impressive. [[user:Briess|Briess]] is a credit to his team.

His Bay 12 forum profile is [http://www.bay12forums.com/smf/index.php?action=profile;u=18951 here.]

[[User:Emi|Emi]] has been keeping things running for a while now. She is also awesome.

The hosting costs for the wiki have generously been provided by [https://www.kitfoxgames.com Kitfox Games] since November 2022.
